title: 全闭眼（c04 持稳）

image_gen_arguments.prompt: Edit only the eyelids of image 1 for the fully closed phase of a relaxed natural blink. Both eyes are completely shut with simple gently downward-curving eyelid lines; no iris, pupil or white remains visible. Keep the exact head angle, eyebrows, slight open smile and glasses position. Keep the complete transparent frame and her identity: round glasses, grey bun, three red hairpin beads. Preserve both hands, fingers, the pod with exactly TWO seated beans, blouse, shoulders, bangle, basin, legs, shoes and every stool corner/foot exactly as image 1. No loose pea, extra object or text.

semantic_acceptance: 两眼真正全闭，不能残留眼白/黑瞳。
眼睑是自然闭合线，不画成抬颊大笑眯眼。
头、口、手荚与 c04/f01 相容；f01 未通过不能用别态冒充。
